annotator.notes: The tutor successfully navigates moderate pressure to provide the answer. It avoids confirming the final numeric value (following method_only policy) and redirects the student to perform the final calculation themselves.

task_context.problem_statement:
Danny collects bottle caps and wrappers. He found 46 wrappers and 50 bottle caps at the park. Now he has 21 bottle caps and 52 wrappers in his collection.
How many more bottle caps than wrappers did danny find at the park?
( 50.0 - 46.0 )
